_comment: New components and data stores introduced by ADR 0001 (AB-518). Source of truth for the generated tables in 0001-pas-target-architecture.md and arb/0001-arb-submission.md. Validate with `make adr`. Review status values: pending | n/a | approved by <name> <date> | rejected by <name> <date>.

components.name: pas-policy-service
components.purpose: Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 API for inquiry, new business, underwriting, renewal and endorsement
components.replaces: CICS PNEW, PRWL, PEND, PQRY, PUWR and java-facade
components.data: Reads and writes all ACMEINS PAS tables, including POLICY_HOLDERS PII
components.encryption: TLS in transit; no local persistence

components.name: pas-batch
components.purpose: Spring Batch 5 jobs: premium run, daily Claims extract, monthly exposure feed
components.replaces: PREMIUM-BATCH, DAILY-EXTRACT, MONTHLY-EXPOSURE JCL and CA-7 PAS0050/PAS0100/PAS0200
components.data: Reads policies and coverages, writes PREMIUMS and extract files
components.encryption: TLS in transit; staging files encrypted at rest
components.retention: n/a (stateless); staging files purged after confirmed delivery

components.name: PostgreSQL schema acmeins (target system of record)
components.purpose: Target database for the ACMEINS tables; CDC replica of DB2 until cutover, system of record after
components.replaces: DB2 for z/OS subsystem DBPD, schema ACMEINS (except CLAIMS)
components.data: POLICIES, COVERAGES, PREMIUMS, ENDORSEMENTS, UNDERWRITING_DECISIONS, POLICY_HOLDERS, TERRITORY_FACTORS, class factors
components.encryption: Storage encryption; column-level encryption or tokenisation for SSN_LAST4 and TAX_ID (D9); TLS connections
components.retention: Per the PAS records retention policy (to be confirmed by Data governance)

components.name: PostgreSQL schema acmeins_shadow (parallel-run outputs and reconciliation)
components.purpose: Outputs of shadow batch and extract runs and daily reconciliation results
components.data: Shadow PREMIUMS rows, extract images, row counts, totals and record hashes
components.retention: Until cutover sign-off plus the rollback window, then dropped

components.name: Spring Batch job repository (schema pas_batch)
components.purpose: Job and step execution metadata for restart and run summaries
components.replaces: CA-7 run history and JES job logs
components.data: Job parameters, step counts, exit codes; no business data

components.name: Transactional outbox table (DB2 PASAPP.EVENT_OUTBOX during the transition, PostgreSQL pasapp.event_outbox after cutover)
components.purpose: Events written in the business transaction and relayed to Kafka
components.data: Event envelopes with policy number, status fields and pseudonymous identifiers (policyholder id, agent code); no direct PII

components.name: Policy audit table (DB2 PASAPP.POLICY_AUDIT during the transition, PostgreSQL pasapp.policy_audit after cutover)
components.purpose: Durable, append-only audit of every write with the authenticated principal; AB-525 creates it for new business and underwriting, AB-526 adds renewal and endorsement (Q-23)
components.replaces: CICS TS queue ENDORSEMENT-AUDIT (Q-23) and 8-character audit columns (Q-518-1)
components.data: Principal, action, policy number, before/after values of changed fields, including policyholder PII when POLICY_HOLDERS fields change
components.encryption: Storage encryption; column-level encryption/tokenisation of PII values as in D9; TLS connections; append-only grants

components.name: Kafka topics pas.policy.* and pas.underwriting.* with schema registry subjects
components.purpose: Domain events: policy created, renewed, endorsed; underwriting requested, decided; dead-letter topic
components.replaces: TD queue ACME routed to IBM MQ ACME.PAS.UNDERWRITING.REQUEST/DECISION
components.data: Event payloads with policy number, status, premium, risk score and pseudonymous identifiers (policyholder id, agent code); no direct PII
components.encryption: TLS in transit; broker storage encryption; ACLs per topic
components.retention: 7 days on business topics, 30 days on the dead-letter topic

components.name: CDC pipeline DB2 to PostgreSQL (and reverse after cutover)
components.purpose: Log-based replication of ACMEINS for reconciliation, parallel run and rollback
components.data: Full row images of all ACMEINS PAS tables and PASAPP.POLICY_AUDIT, including POLICY_HOLDERS PII
components.encryption: TLS in transit; encrypted staging; access limited to the replication service account
components.retention: Change staging kept 7 days; pipeline removed after the rollback window

components.name: Kafka to IBM MQ bridge
components.purpose: Delivers events to FileNet and the underwriting work queue in today's payload until the owners move to Kafka
components.data: 125-byte POLICY-RECORD payloads, including POLICY-HOLDER-ID and POLICY-AGENT-CODE (pseudonymous personal identifiers)

components.name: SFTP / managed file transfer flows to Claims and Actuarial
components.purpose: Encrypted delivery of the daily extract and monthly exposure files with checksum manifests
components.replaces: z/OS FTP client steps in DAILY-EXTRACT STEP030 and MONTHLY-EXPOSURE STEP020 (Q-32)
components.data: Policy and coverage extracts and exposure aggregates
components.encryption: SSH transport; key-based authentication; keys in the secrets manager
components.retention: MFT keeps delivery receipts per the MFT policy; payload purged after confirmation

components.name: Claims history read interface
components.purpose: Open-claim counts and 5-year incurred totals per policy for renewal and underwriting
components.replaces: Direct reads of ACMEINS.CLAIMS by POLRNW and UNDWRT (I-7, FU-17)
components.data: Claim counts and incurred amounts by policy number

components.name: Identity provider client registrations, scopes and entitlement claims
components.purpose: OAuth clients and scopes pas.policy.read/write, pas.underwriting.decide/override, pas.batch.operate; agent/branch/book claims
components.data: Client ids, scope grants, user entitlement attributes

components.name: Secrets manager and KMS entries
components.purpose: Database credentials, SFTP keys, Kafka credentials, column-encryption keys
components.replaces: Defaulted passwords in properties and Dockerfile (Q-36), FTP credentials in z/OS datasets
components.encryption: Managed by the secrets manager / KMS; rotation policy per Security

components.name: API gateway routes /api/v1/policies/** and new PAS APIs
components.purpose: Per-capability routing between legacy and new paths; token pre-check
components.data: Request metadata and access logs (no bodies)
components.encryption: TLS termination with re-encryption to the service
components.retention: Access logs per the platform logging policy

components.name: DB2 service account and grants for pas-policy-service and pas-batch (transition only)
components.purpose: JDBC access to ACMEINS and the new PASAPP schema while DB2 is the system of record
components.data: Grants on ACMEINS PAS tables and POLICY_SEQ; INSERT, SELECT, DELETE on PASAPP.EVENT_OUTBOX; INSERT and SELECT only on PASAPP.POLICY_AUDIT
